plugins.name: cairn
plugins.description: A lean, on-demand, non-invasive development workflow for Claude Code: rules with evidence, corrections queued as candidates, nothing applied without your approval.

plugins.name: cairn-meter
plugins.description: Token and cost metering for Claude Code sessions, with a local dashboard. Works on its own; writes a usage.json export when a project has .cairn/.

plugins.name: cairn-board
plugins.description: A read-only kanban for a project's cairn tasks, with cost per task when cairn-meter's usage export exists.
